Here's a summary of the four fixes:

| Issue | Root Cause | Fix |
|-------|-----------|-----|
| **CS2002 duplicates** | `Compile Include` re-added files the SDK already globs | Changed to `Compile Update` (line 16) — adds metadata only |
| **Cartesian product validation** | Two `%(...)` item types in one task → cross-join batching | Added `Outputs="%(ProtoFile.Identity)"` for target batching + `@()` transform for rules (lines 47-50) |
| **FileWrites not tracked** | Static ItemGroup evaluated at load time, not tied to build | Moved `FileWrites` inside `GenerateProtoCode` target (line 37) |
| **Clean too broad** | `Compile Remove="**\*.g.cs"` didn't delete files & was overly broad | Replaced with `Delete` task targeting only generated files (line 55) |
